result_expr: Integral(rho*c*Derivative(T(x, t), t)*w(x), (x, 0, L)) + Integral(k(x)*Derivative(T(x, t), x)*Derivative(w(x), x), (x, 0, L)) - Integral(Q(x)*w(x), (x, 0, L)) - Subs(k(x)*Derivative(T(x, t), x)*w(x), x, L) + Subs(k(x)*Derivative(T(x, t), x)*w(x), x, 0)

steps.statement: rho*c*dT/dt = d/dx(k*dT/dx) + Q; every term is in W m^-3
steps.operation: given strong form, with a units check
move all terms to the left side

steps.statement: Int_0^L rho*c*T_t*w dx - Int_0^L (k*T_x)_x*w dx - Int_0^L Q*w dx = 0; every term is in W m^-2

steps.operation: integration by parts (product rule plus fundamental theorem of calculus, using smoothness)

steps.statement: Int_0^L rho*c*T_t*w dx - [k*T_x*w]_0^L + Int_0^L k*T_x*w_x dx - Int_0^L Q*w dx = 0
R = Int_0^L rho*c*T_t*w dx + Int_0^L k*T_x*w_x dx - Int_0^L Q*w dx - (k*T_x*w)|_{x=L} + (k*T_x*w)|_{x=0} = 0
steps.operation: expand the boundary bracket and collect terms

assumptions_used: rho and c are constant (from the work order)
T, w, k and Q are smooth on [0, L], so integration by parts is valid (from the work order)
w is not assumed to vanish at x = 0 or x = L, so both boundary flux terms are kept
Sign convention: R is the integral of (rho*c*T_t - (k*T_x)_x - Q)*w after integration by parts, so the storage term carries a plus sign
